hero.heading: Areas We Cover
hero.body: Western Cars provides taxi and private-hire services across Henfield and the surrounding West Sussex area.

intro: Western Cars serves Henfield and a wide range of surrounding towns and villages in West Sussex. Whether you need a local journey, an airport transfer or a longer-distance trip, we are here to help.
